# Third-party components

AetherScale can automatically bootstrap the project-owned native bridge and caller helper from:

- `lisitskyaa/ComfyUI-DLSS5-NR` v0.2.0
- License: MIT
- Upstream source: https://github.com/lisitskyaa/ComfyUI-DLSS5-NR

The corresponding MIT license is included in `ComfyUI-DLSS5-NR-LICENSE.txt`.

No NVIDIA proprietary runtime DLL is included in AetherScale.
